title: A Murder of Necessity
notes: Niyyah was revealed as the apple murder victim. The mission won the full $20,000. Victor's 'Fruitgate' theory about Joe and Tomica was dismissed, and Katie and Ben steered the vote onto Michael, who was banished as a Faithful. Victor and Wyatt each reportedly got 3 votes, but only one recap gives the count, so no close call is scored.
